response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang backgrounds, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, GPU/accelerator work, or deep-learning workload optimization — the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. While he has some low-latency systems experience and meets the years-of-experience bar, the domain mismatch is fundamental for a principal-level hardware performance position.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded
Some systems-level experience: low-latency DLang services with async I/O, fibers, and caching at scale
Strong engineering culture: TDD, open-source contributions, workshops, and community teaching
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning training/inference optimization background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or DL workload expertise
